platform_info.name: ChatGPT
platform_info.description: Handles DDPs in English. These data donation flows have not been tested yet, if you find anything wrong with them report to datadonation@uu.nl and they will be fixed!

description.en: Your conversations with ChatGPT, sorted over time. You can read back what you discussed and see how you've used AI assistance.
description.nl: Uw gesprekken met ChatGPT, gesorteerd op tijd. U kunt teruglezen wat u heeft besproken en zien hoe u AI-assistentie heeft gebruikt.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one message turn in a ChatGPT conversation, including the role (user or assistant), the message text, the model used, and the timestamp.

columns.conversation title: Title of the conversation as stored in the export.
columns.role: Role of the message author: 'user' or 'assistant'.
columns.model: ChatGPT model slug used to generate the assistant reply.
columns.time: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the message was created.
